s.h1: Furniture made for the sun, the sea and the sunset.
s.hp: Hand-woven synthetic rattan for beachfront homes, ocean-view terraces and rooftop stays.

tuff.d: Engineered with dense, soft polyethylene blades in a natural two-tone spring-and-emerald green blend. It delivers the look and underfoot comfort of freshly manicured grass without watering, mowing, mud, or fertilizers.

canopy.d: Densely woven with lifelike dark-green foliage attached to a flexible, breathable mesh grid backing. It blocks unwanted views, reduces dust and harsh glare, and transforms bare walls or chain-link railings into a lush vertical garden.
